name: Himanshu Parida / ହିମାଂଶୁ ପରିଡା

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Himanshu Parida’s work in Kabita Live spans Odia and English poetry. His interest in the craft of writing also finds a place in Metaphor O Ehara Upajogita, an Odia book published by Pakshighar Prakashanee.

‘ଅଚିର’ sets the poet’s impulse to build and repair against the slow undoing of bodies, buildings and memorials. ‘My Mother’s Death’ approaches loss through the practical details of a household: a stopped newspaper, an empty chair, cancelled visits and food left over. The ordinary routine continues, making the absence within it all the more palpable.
